data.name: Khuwailah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root khawwala, which means 'to be bright'. In Islamic tradition, Khuwailah represents the radiant and resplendent full moon, symbolizing guidance and wisdom. It is also the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for her piety and generosity.

A time of peace and tranquility, the moon's radiant light illuminates the night sky, and its consistent cycle is a reminder of the passage of time. The name Khuwailah, derived from the Arabic root meaning 'to be bright', honors this celestial body and its role in our lives.
data.spiritual_significance: Symbolically, the name Khuwailah carries a deep spiritual meaning, representing enlightenment, guidance, and wisdom. Khuwailah, as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), embodied these virtues through her piety and generosity. Her name serves as a reminder to seek knowledge, uphold good deeds, and be a light of guidance to others - just like the full moon in the night sky.
